% Design classes used by the Search for Artist, Create Event, and Review Report
% sequence diagrams (Alex Garcia). Needs pgf-umlcd and graphicx. Included from team_doc_template.tex.

\subsection*{Controllers, services, and repositories}

\begin{center}\rotatebox{90}{\resizebox{0.92\textheight}{!}{%
\begin{tikzpicture}
  % ---------- Controllers ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=10cm]{ArtistController}{0,0}
    \operation{+ searchArtists(fanId : Long, name : String, genre : String,}
    \operation{\quad location : String, lat : Double, lng : Double,}
    \operation{\quad radiusKm : Double) : List\textless ArtistSearchResult\textgreater}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=10cm]{EventController}{12,0}
    \operation{+ createEvent(userId : Long, request : CreateEventRequest) : Event}
    \operation{+ getMyEvents(userId : Long) : List\textless Event\textgreater}
    \operation{+ updateEvent(id : Long, updatedEvent : Event) : Event}
    \operation{+ getAllEvents() : List\textless Event\textgreater}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=10.5cm]{ReportController}{24,0}
    \operation{+ getPendingReports(adminId : Long, type : ReportTargetType) : List\textless Report\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getReport(adminId : Long, reportId : Long) : Report}
    \operation{+ resolveReport(adminId : Long, reportId : Long,}
    \operation{\quad request : ResolveReportRequest) : Report}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Services ----------
  \begin{class}[text width=10cm]{ArtistService}{0,-5.5}
    \attribute{- MAX\_RADIUS\_KM : double = 500}
    \operation{+ searchArtists(fanId : Long, criteria : ArtistSearchCriteria)}
    \operation{\quad : List\textless ArtistSearchResult\textgreater}
    \operation{- resolveOrigin(fan : UserAccount, criteria : ArtistSearchCriteria) : double[2]}
    \operation{- searchNearby(name, genre, location : String, lat, lng, radiusKm : double)}
    \operation{\quad : List\textless ArtistSearchResult\textgreater}
    \operation{\underline{distanceKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 : double) : double}}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=10cm]{EventService}{12,-5.5}
    \operation{+ createEvent(userId : Long, request : CreateEventRequest) : Event}
    \operation{+ getEventsForArtist(userId : Long) : List\textless Event\textgreater}
    \operation{+ updateEvent(eventId : Long, updatedInfo : Event) : Event}
    \operation{\textasciitilde\ validateEvent(request : CreateEventRequest) : void}
    \operation{- validateEventInput(event : Event) : void}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=10.5cm]{ReportService}{24,-5.5}
    \operation{+ getPendingReports(adminId : Long, type : ReportTargetType) : List\textless Report\textgreater}
    \operation{+ getReport(adminId : Long, reportId : Long) : Report}
    \operation{+ resolveReport(adminId : Long, reportId : Long,}
    \operation{\quad request : ResolveReportRequest) : Report}
    \operation{- applyAction(report : Report, action : ModerationAction) : void}
    \operation{- removeContent(report : Report) : void}
    \operation{- setAccountStatus(userId : Long, status : AccountStatus) : void}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=8cm]{AccessControlService}{10,-12.5}
    \operation{+ requireRole(userId : Long, role : Role) : UserAccount}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=8.5cm]{NotificationService}{32,-12.5}
    \operation{+ notify(recipientId : Long, message : String) : Notification}
    \operation{+ getNotifications(recipientId : Long) : List\textless Notification\textgreater}
  \end{class}

  % ---------- Repositories (Spring Data JpaRepository interfaces) ----------
  \begin{interface}[text width=8cm]{ArtistRepository}{0,-17.5}
    \operation{+ search(name, genre, location : String) : List\textless Artist\textgreater}
    \operation{+ searchWithinBounds(name, genre, location : String,}
    \operation{\quad minLat, maxLat, minLng, maxLng : double) : List\textless Artist\textgreater}
  \end{interface}
  \begin{interface}[text width=6cm]{UserAccountRepository}{9,-17.5}
    \operation{+ findById(id : Long) : UserAccount}
    \operation{+ save(account : UserAccount) : UserAccount}
  \end{interface}
  \begin{interface}[text width=7.5cm]{EventRepository}{16,-17.5}
    \operation{+ save(event : Event) : Event}
    \operation{+ findById(id : Long) : Event}
    \operation{+ findByArtistId(artistId : Long)}
    \operation{\quad : List\textless Event\textgreater}
    \operation{+ findByArtistIdOrderByStartsAtAsc(}
    \operation{\quad artistId : Long) : List\textless Event\textgreater}
  \end{interface}
  \begin{interface}[text width=7cm]{ReportRepository}{24.5,-17.5}
    \operation{+ findQueue(status : ReportStatus,}
    \operation{\quad type : ReportTargetType) : List\textless Report\textgreater}
    \operation{+ findById(id : Long) : Report}
    \operation{+ save(report : Report) : Report}
  \end{interface}
  \begin{interface}[text width=5cm]{PostRepository}{32.5,-17.5}
    \operation{+ findById(id : Long) : Post}
    \operation{+ save(post : Post) : Post}
  \end{interface}
  \begin{interface}[text width=7cm]{NotificationRepository}{38.5,-17.5}
    \operation{+ save(n : Notification) : Notification}
    \operation{+ findByRecipientIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(}
    \operation{\quad recipientId : Long) : List\textless Notification\textgreater}
  \end{interface}

  % ---------- Relationships ----------
  \unidirectionalAssociation{ArtistController}{}{1}{ArtistService}
  \unidirectionalAssociation{EventController}{}{1}{EventService}
  \unidirectionalAssociation{ReportController}{}{1}{ReportService}

  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (ArtistService.south) -- (AccessControlService.north west);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (EventService.south) -- (AccessControlService.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (ReportService.south west) -- (AccessControlService.north east);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (ReportService.south east) -- (NotificationService.north);

  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (AccessControlService.south) -- (UserAccountRepository.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (ArtistService.south west) -- (ArtistRepository.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (EventService.south east) -- (EventRepository.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (ReportService.south) -- (ReportRepository.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (ReportService.south) -- (PostRepository.north);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (ReportService.south) -- (EventRepository.north east);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (ReportService.south) -- (UserAccountRepository.north east);
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (NotificationService.south) -- (NotificationRepository.north);
\end{tikzpicture}}}\end{center}

\clearpage
\subsection*{Entities, request/response objects, and enumerations}

\begin{center}\rotatebox{90}{\resizebox{0.92\textheight}{!}{%
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{class}[text width=6cm]{UserAccount}{0,0}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- username : String}
    \attribute{- displayName : String}
    \attribute{- role : Role}
    \attribute{- status : AccountStatus}
    \attribute{- artistId : Long [0..1]}
    \attribute{- latitude : Double [0..1]}
    \attribute{- longitude : Double [0..1]}
    \attribute{- searchRadiusKm : Double [0..1]}
    \operation{+ isActive() : boolean}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=6cm]{Artist}{0,-8.5}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- name : String}
    \attribute{- genre : String}
    \attribute{- location : String}
    \attribute{- profileThumbnail : String}
    \attribute{- bio : String}
    \attribute{- tags : String}
    \attribute{- isSuspended : boolean}
    \attribute{- latitude : Double}
    \attribute{- longitude : Double}
    \operation{+ isSuspended() : boolean}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=6.5cm]{Event}{8.5,0}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- artistId : Long}
    \attribute{- eventType : String}
    \attribute{- title : String}
    \attribute{- description : String}
    \attribute{- startsAt : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{- location : String}
    \attribute{- virtual : boolean}
    \attribute{- capacity : Integer}
    \attribute{- imageUrl : String}
    \attribute{- status : EventStatus}
    \attribute{- reviewedAcknowledgment : boolean}
    \attribute{- createdAt : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{- updatedAt : LocalDateTime}
    \operation{+ getEventDate() : LocalDateTime}
    \operation{+ isReviewedAcknowledgment() : boolean}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=4.5cm]{TicketTier}{8.5,-8.5}
    \attribute{- name : String}
    \attribute{- price : BigDecimal}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{Report}{17.5,0}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- reporterId : Long}
    \attribute{- targetType : ReportTargetType}
    \attribute{- targetId : Long}
    \attribute{- reportedUserId : Long}
    \attribute{- reason : String}
    \attribute{- status : ReportStatus}
    \attribute{- createdAt : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{- action : ModerationAction [0..1]}
    \attribute{- resolvedBy : Long [0..1]}
    \attribute{- resolvedAt : LocalDateTime [0..1]}
    \attribute{- resolutionNotes : String [0..1]}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=6cm]{Notification}{17.5,-10.5}
    \attribute{- id : Long}
    \attribute{- recipientId : Long}
    \attribute{- message : String}
    \attribute{- createdAt : LocalDateTime}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{ArtistSearchCriteria}{27,0}
    \attribute{+ name, genre, location : String}
    \attribute{+ latitude, longitude : Double [0..1]}
    \attribute{+ radiusKm : Double [0..1]}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{ArtistSearchResult}{27,-3.6}
    \attribute{+ id : Long}
    \attribute{+ name, genre, location : String}
    \attribute{+ profileThumbnail : String}
    \attribute{+ distanceKm : Double [0..1]}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{CreateEventRequest}{27,-7.6}
    \attribute{+ title, description, location : String}
    \attribute{+ startsAt : LocalDateTime}
    \attribute{+ virtual : boolean}
    \attribute{+ capacity : Integer}
    \attribute{+ ticketTiers : List\textless TicketTierRequest\textgreater}
    \attribute{+ saveAsDraft : boolean}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=7.5cm]{ResolveReportRequest}{27,-13.2}
    \attribute{+ action : ModerationAction}
    \attribute{+ notes : String}
  \end{class}

  \begin{class}[text width=4.6cm]{Role}{-7,0}
    \attribute{\emph{$\ll$enumeration$\gg$}}
    \attribute{FAN, ARTIST, ADMIN}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=4.6cm]{AccountStatus}{-7,-2.8}
    \attribute{\emph{$\ll$enumeration$\gg$}}
    \attribute{ACTIVE, SUSPENDED,}
    \attribute{BANNED}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=4.6cm]{EventStatus}{-7,-6}
    \attribute{\emph{$\ll$enumeration$\gg$}}
    \attribute{DRAFT,}
    \attribute{PENDING\_APPROVAL,}
    \attribute{PUBLISHED, REMOVED}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=4.6cm]{ModerationAction}{-7,-9.8}
    \attribute{\emph{$\ll$enumeration$\gg$}}
    \attribute{DISMISS, WARN\_USER,}
    \attribute{REMOVE\_CONTENT,}
    \attribute{SUSPEND\_USER, BAN\_USER}
  \end{class}
  \begin{class}[text width=4.6cm]{ReportTargetType}{-7,-14}
    \attribute{\emph{$\ll$enumeration$\gg$}}
    \attribute{POST, EVENT, USER}
  \end{class}

  \composition{Event}{ticketTiers}{1..*}{TicketTier}
  \unidirectionalAssociation{UserAccount}{artist profile}{0..1}{Artist}
  \draw[umlcd style, ->] (Event.west) -- node[above, font=\small]{proposed by} (UserAccount.east);
  \unidirectionalAssociation{Report}{notifies}{0..2}{Notification}
\end{tikzpicture}}}\end{center}
